text:
maria: Quick check for the Lighthouse cutover (Tue 0900 PT) — we need owners and blockers: egress fallback plan, NAT/GW config, air-gap image sync status, KV cache warmup, and CR reviews. Who's owning NAT and the firewall exceptions? @kevin? :eyes:
sam: I can take the firewall exceptions list. Do we have the CIDR ranges from customer?
kevin: Yup, I own the NAT/GW config. Quick status: provisioning in account staging, script landed but needs firewall rules to be opened and a cert rotation after image sync. ETA for NAT config: EOD Mon if rules cleared.
tara: Customer still has one outstanding cert rotation in their ticket (YAML attached). They're waiting on our thumbprint to generate. I pinged them this morning, they said they'd complete by end of day.
maria: Thanks. Sam — can you paste the minimal rules you need? Also we need a named owner for air-gap image sync (registry sync + checksum verify).
sam: Minimal rules: allow outbound TCP 443 to these IPs, and inbound from NAT to app-range. snippet:
```
- allow tcp 443 to 34.210.120.0/24
- allow tcp 443 to 3.22.45.0/24
- allow tcp from 10.32.0.0/16 to 10.33.0.0/16
```
jonah: I'll own the air-gap image sync. Plan: rsync images to airgapped registry, run checksum, then trigger deploy-bot canary. Need access to their SFTP host and the registry creds.
maria: Awesome — @jonah is owner. Jonah, can you drop the runbook link and a quick manual step list? Also we still need one CR approval (infra/dedicated-runtime) — @kevin or @sam can you +1 or tag reviewer?
jonah: Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/lighthouse-airgap — steps in short: 1) rsync -> 2) sha256 verify -> 3) import to local registry -> 4) tag -> 5) smoke. I'll paste small checklist in the doc later.
kevin: I can review the CR today. Please @me the PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4462 — I'll aim to merge after smoke.
ci-bot: Deploy snapshot: staging-2026-03-15T22:08 passed smoke, canary queued for 1768410800. Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/3412
tara: FYI — customer asked if we can do a short weekend window instead if Tue can't land. They said risk window is low but prefer Saturday morning.
maria: Noted. If NAT/GW and cert rotate can't be done Mon, we'll fall back to Saturday. kevin — how brittle is the canary timing?
kevin: Canary can shift +/- 24h, but we need images and firewall prepped. If we miss Mon EOD, we should target Sat 0800 PT.
sam: I'll request the firewall changes now and cc netops. Ping me if infra needs anything from ops.
maria: Great. Owners summary: NAT/GW & CR review -> kevin, firewall rules -> sam, air-gap image sync -> jonah, customer liaison -> tara. Blockers: customer cert rotation (tara), registry creds (jonah waiting), firewall exceptions (sam in-flight). Next check-in: tomorrow 1100 PT. :white_check_mark:
kevin: +1 on the owner list.
jonah: copying registry creds request to ops ticket #8672.
ci-bot: Reminder: attach the canary checklist to the PR to auto-trigger fallback on error.
maria: Done — I'll update the runbook with fallback links and ping this channel when PR merged. Thanks everyone. :tada:
